quest.title: Monumental Study
quest.description: Sosi's research doesn't seem to be going well...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x15000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.text: Lady Sorush, and the two of you as well. Perfect timing!

dialogues.text: Us Skeptics? You might want to re-organize your thoughts before speaking up.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Sosi in detail about what Nasejuna had done...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Is that so... But the incident seems completely arbitrary. His actions have undoubtedly violated the Order of Skeptics' true purpose, so one shouldn't generalize that to the whole order.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But isn't he the uh, Vijnanapati? Are you really gonna let this slide?

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Let's put his nonconforming deeds aside for now. There's something of higher importance I need your opinion on... and it has something to do with Lady Sorush.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then... Since it has to do with Sorush, Paimon supposes we'll hear you out.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Please, come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it something you can't say here?

dialogues.speaker: Sosi

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does Sosi want to show us? Isn't this just one big stone tablet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... did it get eroded? Paimon can't make out what's written on it...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: The Khvarena Monument is a valuable artifact to the Order of Skeptics. It only appears this way because its fragments are lost.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Engraved on the monument are the true names of every Pari and the first contract they formed with the Order of Skeptics.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: The immortality of the Pari is sustained by the Khvarena Monument. One who manages to collect all four fragments and causes the contract to reappear...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: ...Will re-establish a contract with the Pari and obtain a power that rivals the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds nice and all, but what does that have to do with us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're not interested in obtaining the power of the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As for forming contracts with Pari... We're already friends with Sorush, so Paimon thinks there's no need for formalities like that!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Who told you we were friends? Do mind your manners, Pale Floater.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, you do have a point. We'll be friends once Paimon returns the favor by coming up with an ugly nickname for you! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: #Hmph! Paimon's disrespectful behavior aside, I assume you're planning to task {NICKNAME} with collecting the monument's fragments?

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: That's very observant of you, Lady Sorush. That is indeed my plan.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Searching is quite a lowly task— Ahem, a task requiring adventure experience is better suited for professionals. And by that, I mean adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: So you seek to form a new contract with us Pari and acquire a power that rivals the gods?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Oh, how very interesting. A mere human, coveting a higher power... Could it be your inflated ego, or utter ignorance?

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: How could I have such presumptuous thoughts...! I'm doing all this for the sake of research and bringing the historical truth to light.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: The Akademiya and the Order of Skeptics went separate ways due to a clash in our ideals, but our research has always emphasized history and heritage.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: I have never once coveted a higher power — the only thing I'm after is the contents of the inscription on the Khvarena Monument. It's all for the sake of research, I swear.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: The initial contract between us Skeptics and the Pari, and every single Pari's true name! Isn't that enough to pique your interest?

choices.text: I gotta admit, I am a bit curious.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: I suppose that's no surprise, coming from an adventurer with Lady Sorush's recognition...

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Anyway, this is a formal commission. Please be assured that you will be well compensated by the Order of Skeptics.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, since it's a formal commission with compensation and all, maybe we should give it a go.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Splendid. Here are some clues regarding the locations of the monument's fragments... I trust that you're already familiar with clues like these as experienced adventurers.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Oh, and one more thing. I have indeed sighted suspicious individuals who covet the power of gods. They seem to have come all the way from the snowy lands...

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: I've seen them sneaking around the Khvarena Monument, and it's clear that they're up to no good. They've even started setting up camp nearby...

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: I'm sure you wouldn't put up with these outlanders acting as they please on our land, Lady Sorush?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like the Fatui... We just gotta chase them away, right?

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Yes, that's right, go teach them a lesson. They've set up three separate camps — I'll mark them on your map later.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: There's a commanding officer among them that watches over the whole situation. Perhaps defeating him would teach these outlanders to abide by our rules.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Okay, enough talk. I leave the matter in your hands while I stay here and continue reading up on relevant documents. With Lady Sorush accompanying you, I'm sure everything will go smoothly.

choices.text: Not really. It's not like I can memorize everything...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: How could this be...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'm not surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Sorush

dialogues.text: I—I'm just a little disappointed, that's all... Um, no! It's not because of the divine powers...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: I—I'm just disheartened by the revelation that our predecessor's documentations were factually inaccurate... They chose to leave written records precisely because it was the more reliable medium than passing it down verbally...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: I've skimmed through the inscription, and it looks like it contains records of past disasters... and how our Order of Skeptics predecessors dealt with them. Ugh... It's so different than what I've read about.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: But which version of knowledge corresponds to the truth? I need to continue looking into this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a good thing to want to learn more! But uh... don't turn into someone like that weird Fatui officer!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Careful not to fall prey to seemingly convincing "knowledge" and descend into madnesss...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: That would be an overstatement. We Skeptics believe that true knowledge only surfaces when placed under scrutiny. As long as my will does not falter, I would never stray from the right path.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Thank you for all your hard work on this commission. I hope you're satisfied with the Order of Skeptics's compensation, and wish you a smooth journey ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: Hm? Do you have questions?

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Trust me, I'm a righteous person that only wishes to learn of the original contents of the inscription. There's nothing shady involved, I promise.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: I'm envious of his strength... Ahem, I mean, I've been finding him an eyesore for a while now. He needs to pay the price for openly scheming on our territory...
